general_inspect:complete.label: General appearance
general_inspect:complete.position: At the end of the bed; patient at rest

steps.caption: Observe overall comfort, posture and alertness
Observe breathing effort and exposed skin color

heent_eyes:inspect.label: Inspect pupils, conjunctivae, sclerae and corneas
heent_eyes:inspect.position: Seated, at eye level; explain the light

steps.caption: Inspect both eyes, sclerae and clear corneal surfaces
Gently lower each lower lid to inspect conjunctivae
Approach from the side; compare direct and consensual pupil responses

heent_eyes:eye-movement.label: Check extraocular movements
heent_eyes:eye-movement.position: Seated; target about an arm’s length away

steps.caption: Follow the target through an H; keep the head still
Right eye / right hand: find the red reflex from about 15° temporal
Move closer along the red reflex; inspect disc and retinal vessels
Repeat using your left eye / left hand for the patient’s left eye

heent_ears:complete.label: Otoscopic exam of ears
heent_ears:complete.position: Seated; use a clean, appropriately sized speculum

steps.caption: Adult right ear: draw pinna up/back; brace hand on cheek; advance under direct vision
Adult left ear: draw pinna up/back; brace hand on cheek; advance under direct vision

heent_nose:complete.label: Inspect nose with light source
heent_nose:complete.position: Seated; gently tilt the head back

steps.caption: Lift the tip; direct light into each naris without pressing on the septum
Inspect septum, mucosa and visible turbinates

heent_throat:complete.label: Inspect mouth and throat with light
heent_throat:complete.position: Seated; open mouth. Do not remove a worn mask

steps.caption: Illuminate oral cavity; inspect tongue, mucosa and teeth
Depress the anterior tongue gently; avoid touching the pharynx
Ask “ah”; inspect palate, tonsils and posterior pharynx

heent_sinuses:complete.label: Palpate / percuss sinuses
heent_sinuses:complete.position: Seated; avoid pressure on the eyes

steps.caption: Fingerpads beneath bony brow; ask about frontal tenderness
Palpate over maxillary sinuses; compare sides

lymph_nodes:complete.label: Palpate lymph nodes
lymph_nodes:complete.position: Seated; relax neck and support the arm for axillary examination

steps.caption: Small gentle circles along anterior and posterior cervical chains
Sweep below the mandible, then above each clavicle
Support the arm; palpate axillary walls and apex, then opposite side

thyroid:complete.label: Palpate thyroid
thyroid:complete.position: Seated; neck slightly flexed; examiner behind

steps.caption: Find cricoid, then thyroid isthmus below it
Ask for a swallow; feel the gland rise beneath the fingerpads
Gently displace the trachea and feel each lobe during another swallow
Bring chin toward chest, then return to neutral
Look over each shoulder; stop if painful

neck_rom:brudzinski.label: Perform Brudzinski test
neck_rom:brudzinski.position: Supine; screen for neck injury or instability first

steps.caption: Support occiput and upper chest; gently flex the neck
Observe hips and knees for involuntary flexion; do not force

neck_rom:kernig.label: Perform Kernig test
neck_rom:kernig.position: Supine; stop if painful or resistance is encountered

steps.caption: Support thigh and heel; flex hip and knee to 90°
Keep hip flexed; gently extend knee, observing discomfort/resistance
Return gently and repeat on the opposite leg

heart_auscultate:all.label: Listen at all four heart valve areas, on skin
heart_auscultate:all.position: Reclined; expose only the chest needed; diaphragm directly on skin

steps.caption: Listen — aortic: right 2nd intercostal space
Listen — pulmonic: left 2nd intercostal space
Listen — tricuspid: left lower sternal border
Listen — mitral: left 5th intercostal space, midclavicular

heart_inspect_palpate:complete.label: Inspect / palpate precordium, PMI
heart_inspect_palpate:complete.position: Reclined; chest exposed and remainder draped

steps.caption: Inspect for visible precordial impulses
Fingerpads at left 5th intercostal space, midclavicular line: locate PMI
Heel of hand along left sternal border: feel for heaves
Use palmar bases of fingers at valve areas to assess thrills

jvd:complete.label: Assess jugular venous distention
jvd:complete.position: Recline 30–45°; relax neck; turn head slightly away

steps.caption: Adjust angle and lighting to see the right neck venous pulsation
Observe respiratory variation; distinguish venous from arterial movement
At the highest visible venous point, align horizontal and vertical rulers to sternal angle
Use index and middle fingerpads at each radial artery
Palpate each dorsalis pedis, just lateral to extensor hallucis tendon
Palpate posterior tibial behind and below medial malleolus; repeat opposite foot
Gently palpate each carotid medial to sternocleidomastoid; ONE SIDE AT A TIME

carotid_auscultate:complete.label: Auscultate carotid arteries
carotid_auscultate:complete.position: Seated or reclined; use the bell lightly on skin

steps.caption: Right carotid: ask for a brief breath hold if comfortable; listen
Allow breathing, then repeat on the left; never compress both carotids

lungs_auscultate:all.label: Listen to lungs — compare both sides, front, back and sides
lungs_auscultate:all.position: Seated; on skin; breathe through open mouth, rest if lightheaded

steps.caption: One full breath at each site — right upper
One full breath at each site — left upper
One full breath at each site — right middle
One full breath at each site — left middle
One full breath at each site — right lower
One full breath at each site — left lower
Arms crossed; compare posterior fields — right upper
Arms crossed; compare posterior fields — left upper
Arms crossed; compare posterior fields — right middle
Arms crossed; compare posterior fields — left middle
Arms crossed; compare posterior fields — right base
Arms crossed; compare posterior fields — left base
Raise arm; listen in midaxillary line — right lateral base
Raise arm; listen in midaxillary line — left lateral base

lungs_percuss:complete.label: Percuss lung fields
lungs_percuss:complete.position: Seated; expose chest/back; arms crossed for posterior fields

steps.caption: Middle finger firm in interspace; strike distal joint with opposite middle fingertip; compare pairs
Middle finger firm in interspace; strike distal joint with opposite middle fingertip; compare pairs
Use ulnar surfaces of hands; ask “ninety-nine” at each paired level

chest_inspect:complete.label: Inspect chest wall
chest_inspect:complete.position: Seated; expose chest with appropriate draping

steps.caption: Observe anterior contour, scars and symmetry at rest
Watch several breaths: rate, effort, accessory muscle use

chest_wall_palpate:complete.label: Palpate chest wall
chest_wall_palpate:complete.position: Seated; ask the patient to indicate tenderness first

steps.caption: Gently palpate costochondral junctions, comparing sides
Palpate ribs; approach the painful area last

abd_inspect:complete.label: Inspect abdomen
abd_inspect:complete.position: Supine; knees supported, arms at sides; abdomen exposed, remainder draped

steps.caption: Look tangentially across abdomen for contour and distention
Inspect skin, scars and visible pulsations

abd_auscultate:sounds.label: Listen for bowel sounds in all four quadrants
abd_auscultate:sounds.position: Supine; auscultate before percussion or palpation

steps.caption: Diaphragm on skin; listen for bowel sounds — right upper
Diaphragm on skin; listen for bowel sounds — left upper
Diaphragm on skin; listen for bowel sounds — left lower
Diaphragm on skin; listen for bowel sounds — right lower
This is a brief screen; absent bowel sounds require prolonged listening

abd_auscultate:bruits.label: Listen for abdominal bruits
abd_auscultate:bruits.position: Supine; bell on skin with light pressure

steps.caption: Listen for vascular sounds — aorta
Listen for vascular sounds — right renal artery
Listen for vascular sounds — left renal artery
Listen for vascular sounds — right iliac artery
Listen for vascular sounds — left iliac artery
Middle finger against skin; strike its distal joint; sample all quadrants

abd_percuss:liver.label: Percuss liver span
abd_percuss:liver.position: Supine; percuss along the RIGHT midclavicular line

steps.caption: From resonant chest, percuss downward to upper border of dullness
From below the umbilicus, percuss upward to lower border of dullness
Measure the distance between the two identified borders

abd_percuss:ascites.label: Check shifting dullness
abd_percuss:ascites.position: Supine, then roll away from the examining side

steps.caption: Percuss from center toward flank; mark transition to dullness if present
Keep the boundary marked; ask the patient to roll away
Wait for fluid to redistribute
Re-percuss the same marked area and compare the boundary

abd_palpate:light.label: Lightly palpate all quadrants; assess guarding
abd_palpate:light.position: Supine; knees supported; ask about pain and examine painful area last

steps.caption: Use warm fingerpads with gentle shallow pressure in each quadrant
Observe the face and abdominal relaxation; distinguish voluntary guarding

abd_palpate:deep.label: Deeply palpate all four quadrants
abd_palpate:deep.position: Supine; first assess with light palpation; stop if painful

steps.caption: Gradually increase depth with flat fingerpads; assess masses/tenderness in all quadrants

abd_palpate:rebound.label: Assess rebound tenderness
abd_palpate:rebound.position: Supine; use only if indicated; explain discomfort and stop if needed

steps.caption: Press slowly and gently at a site away from greatest pain
Release promptly; ask whether release or pressure hurt more
Place fingers just below RIGHT costal margin at midclavicular line
Maintain gentle pressure; ask for inspiration and observe for inspiratory arrest

abd_special:1.label: Assess McBurney-point tenderness
abd_special:1.position: Supine; identify right ASIS and umbilicus

steps.caption: Locate one-third of the distance from right ASIS toward umbilicus
Gently assess focal tenderness at McBurney point; stop if painful
Apply slow pressure in LEFT lower quadrant
Ask specifically whether this produces pain on the RIGHT lower side

abd_special:3.label: Perform psoas test
abd_special:3.position: Supine; resist active RIGHT hip flexion

steps.caption: Support the patient; place hand above right knee
Ask patient to raise thigh against gentle resistance; ask about abdominal pain

abd_special:4.label: Perform obturator test
abd_special:4.position: Supine; gently flex right hip and knee to 90°

steps.caption: Support knee and ankle in hip/knee flexion
Keep knee supported; move ankle outward to internally rotate hip

abd_special:5.label: Check costovertebral-angle tenderness
abd_special:5.position: Seated; expose back and locate 12th rib / spine angle

steps.caption: Lay one hand over the right costovertebral angle; tap gently with ulnar fist
Repeat over the left angle; ask about tenderness

msk_inspect:complete.label: Inspect the affected area
msk_inspect:complete.position: Expose the symptomatic area; compare corresponding sides

steps.caption: Inspect alignment, contour, swelling and skin color

msk_palpate:0.label: Palpate the affected area — point tenderness
msk_palpate:0.position: Support the symptomatic region; examine the most painful spot last

steps.caption: Patient indicates pain; palpate adjacent bony and soft-tissue landmarks

msk_palpate:1.label: Palpate the affected area — paraspinal musculature
msk_palpate:1.position: Seated or prone; back exposed and muscles relaxed

steps.caption: Use fingerpads beside spinous processes; compare paraspinal tissue side to side

msk_palpate:2.label: Palpate the affected area — midline spine
msk_palpate:2.position: Seated; stop for marked pain or concern for injury

steps.caption: Gently palpate successive midline spinous processes for focal tenderness

msk_rom:complete.label: Range of motion
msk_rom:complete.position: Active, comfortable motion first; stabilize the region; do not force

steps.caption: Flex, then return to neutral
Extend, then return to neutral
For the spine: side bend; for limb joints: assess the appropriate side-to-side plane
Assess rotation where anatomically appropriate; compare sides

msk_strength:0.label: Muscle strength testing — upper extremity
msk_strength:0.position: Seated; compare sides and stop if painful

steps.caption: Stabilize shoulder; resist arm abduction
Support elbow; resist flexion and extension
Stabilize forearm; resist wrist extension, comparing sides
Spread fingers against inward resistance; compare sides
Squeeze two examiner fingers; compare grip on the opposite side

msk_strength:1.label: Muscle strength testing — lower extremity
msk_strength:1.position: Seated or supine; stabilize proximal segment and compare sides

steps.caption: Resist hip flexion with hand above the knee
Resist knee extension and flexion at distal leg
Stabilize heel; resist ankle dorsiflexion and plantarflexion
Hold both arms out, palms up; close eyes
Observe for pronation or drift; do not guide the arms

msk_slr:supine.label: Supine straight-leg raise — both legs
msk_slr:supine.position: Supine; support heel; stop if pain occurs

steps.caption: Raise the straight leg at the hip; ask about radiating symptoms — right
Raise the straight leg at the hip; ask about radiating symptoms — left

msk_slr:seated.label: Seated straight-leg raise — both legs
msk_slr:seated.position: Seated on table edge; support heel; stop if pain occurs

steps.caption: Extend the knee with hip flexed; keep ankle relaxed; ask about radiating symptoms — right
Extend the knee with hip flexed; keep ankle relaxed; ask about radiating symptoms — left

gait:complete.label: Observe gait
gait:complete.position: Clear level walkway; guard nearby; use usual aid if needed

steps.caption: Observe the patient walking away: initiation, stride, balance and arm swing
Ask for a comfortable turn, then watch the return

neuro_cn:0.label: Cranial nerve examination — cn ii
neuro_cn:0.position: Seated; usual corrective lenses; test each eye separately

steps.caption: Cover one eye without pressing it; read a near-vision chart at its specified distance
Confrontation: maintain fixation; bring target inward in four quadrants, each eye
Test direct/consensual pupil responses with a light from the side
Follow the target through an H; keep the head still
Inspect lids and pupils; compare direct and consensual light responses

neuro_cn:2.label: Cranial nerve examination — cn v
neuro_cn:2.position: Seated; eyes closed for sensory testing

steps.caption: Compare light touch over forehead, cheek and jaw on both sides
Clench teeth; palpate temporalis and masseter on each side
Ask patient to open jaw against gentle upward resistance under the chin

neuro_cn:3.label: Cranial nerve examination — cn vii
neuro_cn:3.position: Seated; compare both sides of the face

steps.caption: Raise eyebrows; compare forehead movement
Close eyes tightly; gently test eyelid closure without pressing the eyeballs
Smile and show teeth; compare both sides
Puff out both cheeks; look for air escaping

neuro_cn:4.label: Cranial nerve examination — cn viii
neuro_cn:4.position: Seated; examiner behind to prevent lip reading

steps.caption: Occlude/rub the opposite tragus; whisper a number/letter combination
Repeat with a different combination in the other ear

neuro_cn:5.label: Cranial nerve examination — cn ix-x
neuro_cn:5.position: Seated; open mouth; avoid eliciting a gag routinely

steps.caption: Listen to voice; ask about swallowing, then ask patient to say “ah”
Illuminate and watch palate elevation / uvular position
Press down gently while patient shrugs both shoulders
Resist head turn with hand on cheek; compare both sternocleidomastoids

neuro_cn:7.label: Cranial nerve examination — cn xii
neuro_cn:7.position: Seated; inspect tongue at rest first

steps.caption: Inspect for wasting or involuntary movements, then ask to protrude the tongue
Move the tongue from side to side
Push tongue into each cheek against gentle resistance from outside

neuro_sensory:0.label: Sensory examination — light touch
neuro_sensory:0.position: Explain first; eyes closed; compare matching areas bilaterally

steps.caption: Light cotton touch: ask where and whether both sides feel alike

neuro_sensory:1.label: Sensory examination — pinprick
neuro_sensory:1.position: Explain first; eyes closed; compare matching areas bilaterally

steps.caption: Single-use sharp/dull stimulus; never break skin: ask where and whether both sides feel alike

neuro_sensory:2.label: Sensory examination — vibration
neuro_sensory:2.position: Eyes closed; use a 128-Hz tuning fork

steps.caption: Tap the fork, then place its base over distal bony prominence
Ask when vibration starts/stops; compare sides, moving proximally if needed

neuro_sensory:3.label: Sensory examination — proprioception
neuro_sensory:3.position: Explain up/down with eyes open, then test with eyes closed

steps.caption: Hold sides of the distal phalanx; stabilize proximally, avoiding top/bottom pressure
Move the great toe slightly up or down; ask direction; compare sides

neuro_reflexes:dtr.label: Check biceps, triceps, patellar and Achilles reflexes
neuro_reflexes:dtr.position: Relax and support limbs; compare right and left

steps.caption: Biceps: place thumb on tendon; strike your thumb with reflex hammer — right
Biceps: place thumb on tendon; strike your thumb with reflex hammer — left
Triceps: support arm; tap tendon just above olecranon — right
Triceps: support arm; tap tendon just above olecranon — left
Patellar: legs hanging relaxed; strike patellar tendon below the patella — right
Patellar: legs hanging relaxed; strike patellar tendon below the patella — left
Achilles: gently dorsiflex supported foot; strike Achilles tendon — right
Achilles: gently dorsiflex supported foot; strike Achilles tendon — left

neuro_reflexes:plantar.label: Check plantar response (Babinski)
neuro_reflexes:plantar.position: Relaxed foot; use a blunt, noninjurious instrument

steps.caption: Stroke from lateral heel toward little toe, then medially across the ball; observe toes
Repeat on the opposite foot; do not repeatedly scrape the sole

neuro_coordination:0.label: Coordination / cerebellar — finger to nose
neuro_coordination:0.position: Seated; examiner’s target at comfortable reach

steps.caption: Touch own nose, then examiner’s finger; change target position and repeat each arm
Place one heel on opposite knee; slide down the shin toward ankle and back
Repeat with the opposite heel

neuro_coordination:2.label: Coordination / cerebellar — romberg
neuro_coordination:2.position: Stand with feet together; examiner close enough to guard

steps.caption: Observe balance first with eyes open
Close eyes; observe without touching unless needed for safety
Alternate palms and backs of hands on thighs rapidly; compare speed and rhythm

mental_status:complete.label: Mental status / orientation
mental_status:complete.position: Seated; ensure hearing, language and comfort needs are met

steps.caption: Observe behavior and speech; ask name, place and date
Give three unrelated items; ask the patient to repeat them
steps.prompt: Repeat three items to register them

steps.caption: Assess attention and naming with separate prompts
steps.prompt: Months backward; name pen and watch

steps.caption: Allow a two-minute recall interval; converse without rehearsing the items
After two minutes, ask for the three items without cues

skin_inspect:0.label: Inspect skin — chest
skin_inspect:0.position: Expose chest with consent; illuminate; preserve draping elsewhere

steps.caption: Inspect chest: color, lesions, distribution and surface; compare sides

skin_inspect:1.label: Inspect skin — back
skin_inspect:1.position: Expose back with consent; illuminate; preserve draping elsewhere

steps.caption: Inspect back: color, lesions, distribution and surface; compare sides

skin_inspect:2.label: Inspect skin — arms
skin_inspect:2.position: Expose arms with consent; illuminate; preserve draping elsewhere

steps.caption: Inspect arms: color, lesions, distribution and surface; compare sides

skin_inspect:3.label: Inspect skin — legs
skin_inspect:3.position: Expose legs with consent; illuminate; preserve draping elsewhere

steps.caption: Inspect legs: color, lesions, distribution and surface; compare sides

skin_inspect:4.label: Inspect skin — palms
skin_inspect:4.position: Expose palms with consent; illuminate; preserve draping elsewhere

steps.caption: Inspect palms: color, lesions, distribution and surface; compare sides

skin_inspect:5.label: Inspect skin — soles
skin_inspect:5.position: Expose soles with consent; illuminate; preserve draping elsewhere

steps.caption: Inspect soles: color, lesions, distribution and surface; compare sides

skin_palpate:complete.label: Palpate the skin concern
skin_palpate:complete.position: Consent; gloves as indicated; inspect and ask about tenderness first

steps.caption: Use backs of fingers to compare temperature with adjacent/unaffected skin
Gently palpate tenderness and firmness at lesion edge
If appropriate, press gently from opposing sides to assess fluctuance; do not squeeze or drain

extremities:complete.label: Inspect / palpate extremities
extremities:complete.position: Support limbs; compare both sides; respect painful areas

steps.caption: Inspect symmetry, calf size and skin color; measure calves at matching level if needed
Gently assess calf tenderness; do not use forced dorsiflexion as a DVT test
Press over shin/ankle for several seconds, release and inspect indentation
Inspect nail profiles; bring matching nails together for window comparison
Press nail bed about 5 seconds; release and observe color return

osteo_screen:0.label: Osteopathic structural screen — cervical
osteo_screen:0.position: Comfortably supported; expose cervical region; palpation only, no manipulation

steps.caption: Compare cervical tissue texture, landmarks, asymmetry and tenderness
Assess gentle regional motion / spring only within comfort; compare restriction

osteo_screen:1.label: Osteopathic structural screen — thoracic
osteo_screen:1.position: Comfortably supported; expose thoracic region; palpation only, no manipulation

steps.caption: Compare thoracic tissue texture, landmarks, asymmetry and tenderness
Assess gentle regional motion / spring only within comfort; compare restriction

osteo_screen:2.label: Osteopathic structural screen — lumbar
osteo_screen:2.position: Comfortably supported; expose lumbar region; palpation only, no manipulation

steps.caption: Compare lumbar tissue texture, landmarks, asymmetry and tenderness
Assess gentle regional motion / spring only within comfort; compare restriction

osteo_screen:3.label: Osteopathic structural screen — sacrum
osteo_screen:3.position: Comfortably supported; expose sacrum region; palpation only, no manipulation

steps.caption: Compare sacrum tissue texture, landmarks, asymmetry and tenderness
Assess gentle regional motion / spring only within comfort; compare restriction

osteo_screen:4.label: Osteopathic structural screen — ribs
osteo_screen:4.position: Comfortably supported; expose ribs region; palpation only, no manipulation

steps.caption: Compare ribs tissue texture, landmarks, asymmetry and tenderness
Assess gentle regional motion / spring only within comfort; compare restriction

orthostatic_vitals:complete.label: Orthostatic vital signs
orthostatic_vitals:complete.position: Rest supine for 5 minutes; assist standing, guard nearby and stop if unsafe

steps.caption: Rest supine for 5 minutes before the baseline measurement
After supine rest, measure BP and pulse with supported arm at heart level
Assist to stand; keep arm supported at heart level
At 1 minute standing, repeat BP/pulse; ask about symptoms
Continue standing; at 3 minutes repeat BP/pulse and symptoms

neuro_dix_hallpike:screen.label: Check cervical and positional-test suitability first
neuro_dix_hallpike:screen.position: Seated; screen before any rapid positioning

steps.caption: Ask about neck/back injury, instability, vascular problems and positioning tolerance
steps.prompt: Neck injury? Safe to recline and turn?

steps.caption: Check comfortable cervical rotation/extension; defer if unsafe

neuro_dix_hallpike:right.label: Dix–Hallpike, right — includes suitability check
neuro_dix_hallpike:right.position: Screen first; proceed only if suitable; seated with room to recline and head supported

steps.caption: Ask about neck/back injury, instability, vascular problems and positioning tolerance
steps.prompt: Neck injury? Safe to recline and turn?

steps.caption: Check comfortable cervical rotation/extension; defer if unsafe
Turn head 45° to the right; support head throughout
Move promptly to supine with head extended about 20–30° below horizontal
Maintain position; watch eyes for nystagmus and ask about vertigo
Assist back to sitting, maintaining head turn
Observe eyes and symptoms after sitting; allow recovery

neuro_dix_hallpike:left.label: Dix–Hallpike, left — includes suitability check
neuro_dix_hallpike:left.position: Screen first; proceed only if suitable; seated with room to recline and head supported

steps.caption: Ask about neck/back injury, instability, vascular problems and positioning tolerance
steps.prompt: Neck injury? Safe to recline and turn?

steps.caption: Check comfortable cervical rotation/extension; defer if unsafe
Turn head 45° to the left; support head throughout
Move promptly to supine with head extended about 20–30° below horizontal
Maintain position; watch eyes for nystagmus and ask about vertigo
Assist back to sitting, maintaining head turn
Observe eyes and symptoms after sitting; allow recovery
Review supplied BP, pulse, respirations, temperature and oxygen saturation
